remarks: Stunning contemporary 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the desirable Northstar mid-rise featuring sophisticated finishes, exceptional cityviews, and an unbeatable location. This bright, sun-filled unit showcases travertine stone flooring, granite countertops and vanities throughout, a chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances, mosaic glass backsplash, and peninsula bar seating. Spacious bedrooms open to a private balcony with town views. In-unit washer/dryer and modern "Desert Drift" carpeting complete this move-in-ready home - owner may consider putting top-quality Pergo wood floor upon slight rent increase. One block from UCONN, premier shopping, dining, theaters, and Mill River Park with a train station nearby. Secure, assigned parking with reserved space included (additional space might be available). Non-smokers preferred. Credit check required. A small pet with extra pet security may be considered (according to the Condo By-Laws). Owner/Broker.
